events.title: Culture Warz: Tactics demo is officially available to play on Steam!
events.summary: The wait is over! The Culture Warz: Tactics demo is officially available to play on Steam!It's time to take command of your squad of Chads, outsmart the NPCs and defend the Jammers in some good old-fashioned turn-based tactical combat.Plan your moves, combine your squad's abilities and make use of the rewind mechanic when things inevitably go wrong.What to expect from the demo:Grid-based, turn-based tactical combat.Unique squad abilities and strategic gameplay.Plenty of NPCs standing between you

events.title: Our Website Is Playable, For Some Reason...
events.summary: So, here’s the situation.Rear Admiral Games has a website now.This means we are officially a real game studio, according to the ancient laws of the internet-and whichever payment processor accepted our card.We’ve gathered all the important information into one convenient location: who we are, what we’re making, what we’ve already unleashed, and where to report the tactical oopsies we definitely intended to include.There’s also a blog-sorry, an official propaganda feed-where we’ll post updates on

events.title: Humanity Is Cooked. Culture Warz: Tactics Is Coming Soon.
events.summary: So, here’s the situation.A global conspiracy weaponized social media and turned almost everyone into a mindless NPC. The timelines are cursed. The dialogue loops are getting worse. Somewhere, somebody is still typing “Well, actually…”The vibes remain terrible.Humanity’s last hope is an “elite” resistance force of Chads, a collection of glorified signal blockers called Jammers, and you-the tactical genius who was apparently available.Culture Warz: Tactics is a grid-based, turn-based strategy game
